full_text:
Article 6 (Presentation of Persons Subject to Review for Recommendation as Special Prosecutor Candidates)
(1) Persons to be reviewed for recommendation as special prosecutor candidates (hereinafter referred to as "persons subject to review") shall be presented by members of the Committee.
(2) The number of persons subject to review that each member may present under paragraph (1) shall be determined by resolution of the Committee.
